budget_rules.allocation: identical native steps and logical-work limits per case per condition
budget_rules.work: Budget.consume reservations: reset, validation, localization, map updates, decisions, planning edges/nodes, goal/route matching, candidate information rays and native steps
budget_rules.environment_cost: native reset/step calls plus measured wall seconds; work units do not purport to count external-library CPU instructions
budget_rules.replay_cost: separate identical execution limit per case/condition, plus separately reported receipt validation work and wall seconds
budget_rules.instrumentation: snapshot polling and journal serialization are passive overhead, not actor work or policy input
budget_rules.exhaustion: retain actual steps and native terminal outcomes; never drop an exhausted case or silently refund work
budget_rules.instrument_error: journal and propagate; no conversion into agent failure or denominator exclusion

memory.initial: empty for every case and condition; no cross-case learning or holdout persistence
memory.learning: observation-acquired map, transition counts, observed contradictions, supported subgoals
memory.pose: relative to episode origin, estimated from actions and registration of visible static landmarks
memory.unseen: unknown; no full-grid rendering, no absolute hidden coordinates
memory.no_memory: discard prior map, visit counts and evidence on every observation; retain task progress and motor odometry
memory.no_planning: retain observed memory but use only local reactions, no graph or information search

native_goal_phrases: get to the green goal square
use the key to open the door and then get to the goal
mission_grammar.location_scope: initial agent frame; location-sensitive built-in profile is the single-room BabyAI-PickupLoc task
mission_grammar.ambiguity: record multiple observed candidates and unseen alternatives; any satisfying match is legal only if the external verifier agrees
mission_grammar.unsupported: reject unparsed or overlong instructions; no LLM or arbitrary code evaluation
mission_grammar.operator_missions: native BabyAI verifier bound to existing matching objects, or equivalent native MiniGrid goal; never relabel a different MiniGrid objective

seed_rule: base_seed + flat_case_index * 101; interval validated; never passed to actor; seed0 fixed for passive policy only

gates.superiority: informative success wins minus losses >= 1 versus EACH fixed/passive/no_memory/no_planning control; costs reported independently, no cost-only promotion
gates.closure: confirmation cohort, all families/modes, exact contract budget, >=8 cases/family, correctness and measured-success gates, all four superiority comparisons
gates.failure_policy: keep zeroes and negatives; no denominator changes, seed filtering, retries or thresholds changed after confirmation

replay: new native environment, same pinned code/config/seed, full public observations, action decisions, evidence, logical costs and external verdict compared; timings excluded
journal: existing echo5.trace.Recorder.write(kind=..., **facts); sandbox_reset, sandbox_step, sandbox_stop, sandbox_error, sandbox_case_start, sandbox_adjudication, sandbox_instrument_error
limitations: No episodes or CPU tests executed during programming; no performance or closure result is claimed.
Explicit Python object ownership/data-flow boundary, not process isolation against hostile actor code.
Symbolic native mechanics and finite grammar are supplied; learned memory means accumulated observation evidence, not trained policy weights.
Pose ambiguity and moving obstacles can invalidate remembered spatial estimates; all map positions remain labelled estimates.
Candidate identity is descriptive and spatial; visually identical relocated objects are not assigned privileged native identities.
Confirmation holds out seeds, combinations and task rules from development; parser/mechanics deliberately implement those supported rule families beforehand.
Local native task adaptation is not an official MiniGrid/BabyAI benchmark score, general language understanding, physical validation or statistical superiority proof.
